info.description:
Postman collection for the RateYourSchool API. Automatically synchronized with OpenAPI specification.

## Getting Started

1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your API endpoint
3. Run requests and view automated tests

## Variables

- `baseUrl`: Development server (default: http://localhost:5001/v1)
- `prodUrl`: Production server (https://api.rateyourschool.com/v1)

## Architecture

- CQRS pattern with read/write model separation
- MongoDB for data persistence
- Eventual consistency between write and read models
